transfers.name: Magaca

transfers.issuedByUnknown: Waxaa soo saaray dugsiga ka wareejinaya
transfers.createHint: Dugsiga qaabailaya wuxuu arkaa diiwaanka oo dhan - fasalka, natiijooyinka, masuuliyiinta, xaadarka iyo khidmadaha - ka hor inta uusan go aan gaarin. Marka la aqblo ardayga waxaa dib looga diiwa geliyaa dugsiga loo wareejinayo waana ka saarnaataa dugsigan.
transfers.legacyNote: Kayb la qaaday markii wareejintu dhammaatay; fasalka iyo booska fasalka xilligaas lama diiwaan gelin.

elections.title: Doorashada golaha ardayda
elections.subtitle: Kursi — Guddoomiye iyo Ku-xigeen — hal cod oo ay bixiyaan ardayda u qalanta. Saacadda ayaa furaysa oo xirta codbixinta.
elections.setupHint: Hal mar ka fuli {{file}} tafatiraha SQL-ka ee Supabase. Wuxuu abuuraa jadwalada doorashada, sharciga hal-codka iyo saacadda furaysa oo xirta codbixinta, kadib halkan riix Isku-day mar kale.
elections.twoSeats: Kursiyada — Guddoomiye iyo Ku-xigeen — waa la wada abuuraa waana la wada tiriyaa si kala gaar ah.
elections.noneYetHint: Abuur, ku dar musharraxiin ka socda diiwaanka ardayda dhabta ah, ansixi oo daabac, kadib bilow muddada codbixinta.
elections.needCreate: Abuurista doorasho waxay u baahan tahay ogolaanshaha elections.create.
elections.disabledTitle: Qaybta doorashada waa loo damiyay dugsigan
elections.disabledHint: Maamualaha madalka ayaa tan xakameeya. Ardaydu ma arki karaan musharraxiinta mana codeyn karaan ilaa dib loo hawlgeliyo — jadwalka iyo musharraxiinta aad gelisay waa la ilaaliyaa.
elections.created: Doorashada waa la abuuray iyada oo leh kursiyada.
elections.windowHint: Saacadda xoghaynta ayaa furaysa oo xirta — qofna looma baahna inuu soo galo xilligaas.
elections.windowNeeded: Wakhtiga xiritaanka waa inuu ka dambeeyaa wakhtiga furitaanka.
elections.manualHint: Batoon kasta oo halkan yaal waa la diiwaangeliyaa. In la iska dayo waa fiican yahay — saacaddu isla waqtigeeda ayay qabataa.
elections.cancelHint: Codadka la bixiyay waa la hayaa diiwaanka laakiin doorashadu ma soo saarto guuleyste. Ardayda waa loo sheegaa, sababta-na waxaa la geliyaa diiwaanka.
elections.electionCancelled: Doorashada waa la joojiyay waana la diiwaangeliyay.
elections.lockedNote: Codbixintu way bilowatay, sidaas darteed faahfaahinta iyo barnaamijyada musharraxiinta waa la xiray. Ma beddelmi karaan ilaa doorashada la xiro.
elections.studentsSeeFinal: ardaydu natiijooyinka arkaan oo kaliya ka dib xiritaanka
elections.showLiveToStudents: Ardaydu arki karaan tirinta codadka tooska ah inta codbixintu furan tahay
elections.showLiveHint: Haddii la dooran waayay, damay ilaa ka dib xiritaanka. Tirada ka qaybgalka mar walba way muuqataa.
elections.ballotsCount: {{voted}} ka mid ah {{eligible}} arday ayaa codeysay
elections.candidatesHint: Musharrax kastaa waa arday diiwaangashan — liiska waa la doortaa, lama qoro.
elections.candidateSource: Musharraxiintu waa ardayda diiwaangashan. Magac la qoray marnaba ma aha.
elections.noEligible: Ma jiro arday dagan dugsigan oo la heli karo — qof kastaa waa uu taagan yahay ama ma firfircoona.
elections.introduction: Qoraal kooban oo ka muuqda kaarka
elections.shortPromise: Ballan kasta wuxuu u baahan yahay erayo — ama tirtir sadarka madhan.
elections.reasonLabel: Sabab (loo muujiyo musharraxa waana la kaydiyaa diiwaanka)
elections.reasonNeeded: Waxaa loo baahan yahay sabab ugu yaraan saddex xaraf.
elections.noReasonNeeded: Sabab looma baahna tan. Waxaa la geliyaa diiwaanka.
elections.pickOneEach: Dooro hal arday kursiba, kadib xaqiiji.
elections.answeredSeats: {{done}} ka mid ah {{total}} kursi la doortay
elections.oneVoteOnly: Marka la xaqiijiyo, codka lama beddeli karo — ardaygu hal mar buu codeynayaa.
elections.reviewTitle: Hubi codkaaga ka hor inta aadan xaqiijin
elections.reviewHint: Tani waa muuqaalka ugu dambeeya. Cod la xaqiijiyay waa la xiray, adiguma beddeli karo mana beddeli karo dugsiga.
elections.sealedAt: La dhiibay {{at}}. Waa la xiray — dugsigu wuu hayaa tirada, ma aha doorashooyinkaaga.
elections.secretNote: Codkaagu waa sir. Dugsigu wuxuu diiwaangeliyaa inaad codeysay, tirina waa wadarta codadka oo dhan — qofna, oo ay ku jiraan maamualayaasha, ma arki karo ciddii aad dooratay.
elections.resultsLater: Tirada ka qari ardayda ilaa dugsigu daabaco natiijooyinka.
elections.voteSubtitle: Hal cod, laba kursi, hal cod arday kasta oo u qalma.
elections.noElectionLearnerHint: Markii dugsigu furo doorashada golaha ardayda, musharraxiinta iyo codadka halkan ayay ka muuqdaan.
elections.noCandidatesYetHint: Ardaydu waxay arkaan oo kaliya musharraxiinta dugsigu ansixiyay oo daabacay. Soo eeg xilliga doorashada dhowaad.
elections.morePromises: +{{n}} kale oo ku jira profilka buuxa
elections.pausedLearner: Dugsigu hadda wuu hakadsiiyay codbixinta. Musharraxiinta weli waa la muujiyaa — waxa aad akhrisay ma lumayso, codkana dib buu u furmaa marka ay dib u bilaabaan.
elections.cancelledBallot: Doorashadan waa la joojiyay, sidaas darteed cod ma jiro oo la aqbali karo.
elections.ended: Codbixintu si rasmi ah way dhamaatay. Muddada la gudbin lahaa waa la xiray. Waad arki kartaa natiijooyinka doorashada.
elections.percentFormula: Boqolkiiba waa codadka musharraxa la qaybiyay codadka saxda ah ee kursigan.
elections.turnoutLine: {{voted}} ka mid ah {{eligible}} arday u qalma ayaa codeysay ({{pct}}%).
elections.tieTitle: Weli guuleyste ma jiro — kursigu waa is le’eg
elections.liveOffForStudents: Adigaa arki kara tiradan tooska ah. Ardaydu waxay arki doonaan oo kaliya haddii aad ogolaato natiijo toos ah, ama ka dib xiritaanka codbixinta.
elections.secrecyNote: Kooxo oo kaliya. Wax halkan yaal ma xiriirinayaan arday iyo doorasho — sidaas ayay codku ku sir ahaadaa.
elections.exportsHint: Fayl kasta wuxuu sitaa magaca iyo calaamadda dugsiga, cinwaanka iyo muddada doorashada, iyo wadarta aad halkan ka aragto.
elections.exportsLocked: Dhoofintu waxay u baahan tahay ogolaanshaha elections.export.
elections.reportNote: Magaca dugsiga, cinwaanka doorashada, musharraxiinta, codadka, boqolkiibada iyo wadarta. Codbixiye marnaba.
elections.historyHint: Tirinta waa la kaydiyaa, sidaas darteed doorasho dhamaatay waxay haysaa tirooyinkeeda xitaa haddii codadka dib loo kaydiyo.
elections.auditTitle: Wax kasta oo dhacay, si isku xigta
elections.auditHint: Ciddii furtay, hakad gelisay, xirtay ama joojisay muddada, go’aannada la qaatay iyo warbixinadii la dhoofiyay. Codadka halkan lama soo koubo — caqli la aqbalay oo kaliya.
elections.noAccountWarning: {{n}} arday firfircoon ayaa wali akoon soo-gelin leh, sidaas darteed cod lama siin karo mana ku jiraan codbixiyeyaasha u qalma. Akoonnadiisa ka samee Ardayda ka hor inta aan wakhtiga cod bixintu furmin.
